decisions.reason: Having survived the first review and fitting the firm's digital efficiency trajectory after the related Product C was dropped, this adjacent automation offer is likely still above aspiration or close enough to justify continued support.

The web tool is strategically related and probably cheap to maintain, but as a narrow application its usage can more easily fall below aspiration levels, making it the most withdrawal-prone product still kept.

As a very new hardware product close to the core water-control offer, management would usually allow more time for market feedback unless early demand clearly disappoints, so retention remains more likely than withdrawal.

The energy management system closely matches the firm's stated direction toward digital networking, efficiency, and energy recovery, so in a growing market it is likely to receive patience and resources.

A dedicated multi-model product line signals stronger commitment and broader expected applicability, so with organisational slack and strategic fit it is likely to stay unless sales fall clearly short of aspirations.
